summary.text: Nicole Uhre-Balk is a Democratic state representative from District 32 who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a former teacher who works as an education specialist.

paragraphs.text: Nicole Uhre-Balk was born in Rapid City, South Dakota, and graduated from Stevens High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Bethel University in 2006 and a graduate degree from Black Hills State University in 2014.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she spent more than a decade teaching middle and high school biology and computer science before serving in the Legislature.
Uhre-Balk assumed office in the South Dakota House of Representatives on January 14, 2025, and serves on the House Commerce and Energy Committee and the House Education Committee.
In the 2026 survey, she listed her priorities as strong public schools, affordable child care, lower costs for working families, and protecting the Black Hills and clean water.
